frontend.ingress: all, direct IAP on every ingress path
frontend.db: none; current epoch/nonces enforced independently by backend and factory before authority

backend.db: own auth nonce/epoch; existing saved role only under unchanged capability/RLS checks

factory.redis: namespace publisher ACL; no Redis administration

serviceAccountRules: distinct SA per logical workload; worker replicas share their approved backend SA
exact immutable service-account subject and verified email enrollment
resource-scoped roles/run.invoker only for listed callers; per-method authorization remains in application
no Owner/Editor, SA JSON keys, runtime Token Creator/actAs or cross-workload secret access
IAP service agent requires frontend Invoker; testers get resource-scoped roles/iap.httpsResourceAccessor, not backend Invoker

iap.mode: direct Cloud Run IAP, not load-balancer-only IAP
iap.testersDefault: deny until owner approves exact principals
iap.anonymousSavedCapabilitySemantics: unchanged; IAP limits staging exposure, never replaces capability/RLS/expiry/membership

workload.tokenSource: assigned service identity via metadata/auth library only; not implemented/activated here
workload.authorizationHeader: Authorization; no X-Serverless-Authorization alternate path; verify container signature preservation before deployment
workload.audiences: exact stable run.app service URLs; no guessed IDs, traffic-tag or custom-domain substitution

network: Direct VPC egress/internal Cloud Run classification verified before activation
private Redis TLS+AUTH/ACL/noeviction; frontend/backend have no Redis credential
PostgreSQL verify-full, restricted logins and session_user semantics retained through approved pooler
public Google JWKS HTTPS egress only fixed origins; bounded cache expires closed
separately approved provider egress and quotas; no credentials/data-plane permission enabled by this manifest
recovery: witness backups/epoch ownership independent of operational PostgreSQL and Redis
no combined administrator credential in any runtime
restore quarantines at-risk grant; operator reconciliation only; no automated replay/refund
revocation and key rotation use reviewed enrollment versions; stale build/epoch fails; old financial state is never reset
approvalsMissing: actual project/region/service URLs and service-account unique IDs
IAP tester principal allowlist and external/no-organization OAuth configuration
Supabase capacity/pooler/backup/roles and separately reviewed migration
independent witness hosting/backup administration and key custody
real server identity acquisition/request-proof secret rotation and production dependency/image review
container security findings and separately approved resource costs
real financial grants, qualified LLM, provider transport and private staging acceptance
rotationAndRevocation: Independently publish reviewed identity-enrollment versions and exact SA immutable subjects; never infer from an email domain.
Rotate each request-proof key in its own workload secret; bounded overlap must be explicitly reviewed. Revoke old proof keys and caller enrollments without altering financial history.
Bound JWKS cache age to one hour and refresh unknown keys at most once/minute; expired/unavailable trust fails closed. Measure legitimate Google rotation before activation.
Use fixed current audiences; rollout/tag URLs cannot substitute. Build and epoch mismatch invalidates session/request authority; never migrate authority automatically.
Test IAP removal, SA disablement, IAM policy changes and captured-token expiry in staging; do not claim instant token revocation.
